text: PRIORITY RAISED to P2 by the chief at 06:45Z. The full-court audit has now been KILLED MID-RUN TWICE tonight, both times inside this suite. So the finding is no longer 'the JS LawsSuite is slow at 317s' - it is 'a single-command scalafmtCheckAll+compileAll+testAll cannot complete in this environment because of it'. The chief's workaround is to split the audit into four runs (JVM+format+compile, lawsJS alone, other JS modules, Native), which together reported 3,423 tests matching the last completed full court exactly. That works but it is four commands and four chances to mis-specify one - I burned a run on a nonexistent testJS alias doing it. Fix options unchanged and the guardrail still stands: do NOT cut ScalaCheck sample counts to make the number smaller, that is capacity-to-fail in build clothing. Measure which properties account for the 317 seconds first.
